_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: customers
constraints: CHECK (default_price_mode IS NULL OR default_price_mode IN ('EXCL','INCL'))

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "roles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "permissions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "role_permissions" ("role_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES roles (id), "permission_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES permissions (id), PRIMARY KEY ("role_id", "permission_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "username" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "role_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES roles (id), "pin_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "pin_salt" TEXT NOT NULL, "biometric_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("biometric_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "devices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "first_seen_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_seen_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "document_sequences" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "doc_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_number" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (last_number >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "command_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "command_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "result_ref_type" TEXT NULL, "result_ref_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_user_id" TEXT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "summary" TEXT NOT NULL, "before_json" TEXT NULL, "after_json" TEXT NULL, "command_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "backup_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "trigger" TEXT NOT NULL, "destination" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sha256" TEXT NULL, "schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "app_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "result" TEXT NOT NULL, "error_message" TEXT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (result IN ('OK','FAIL')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "locations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_virtual" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_virtual" IN (0, 1)), "is_sellable" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_sellable" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "products" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_normalized" TEXT NOT NULL, "price_coefficient" INTEGER NOT NULL, "dns" TEXT NULL, "foam_type" TEXT NULL, "default_width" INTEGER NULL, "default_height" INTEGER NULL, "standard_thicknesses" TEXT NULL, "default_sale_price_m3" INTEGER NULL, "critical_stock_pieces" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "min_stock_volume" INTEGER NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (price_coefficient > 0), CHECK (critical_stock_pieces >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_variants" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "width" INTEGER NOT NULL, "height" INTEGER NOT NULL, "thickness" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit_volume" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sku" TEXT NULL, "critical_stock_pieces" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (width > 0 AND height > 0 AND thickness > 0), CHECK (unit_volume > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "title_normalized" TEXT NOT NULL, "contact_person" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "tax_office" TEXT NULL, "tax_number" TEXT NULL, "default_price_mode" TEXT NULL, "default_discount_rate" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "risk_limit" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "payment_term_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (default_price_mode IS NULL OR default_price_mode IN ('EXCL','INCL')), CHECK (default_discount_rate >= 0 AND default_discount_rate <= 10000), CHECK (risk_limit >= 0), CHECK (payment_term_days >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "suppliers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "title_normalized" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "contact_person" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "tax_office" TEXT NULL, "tax_number" TEXT NULL, "payment_term_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "price_lists" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version_no" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_price_m3" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rounding_rule" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NONE', "valid_from" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE','ARCHIVED')), CHECK (base_price_m3 > 0), CHECK (version_no > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "price_list_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "price_list_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES price_lists (id), "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "coefficient" INTEGER NOT NULL, "computed_price_m3" INTEGER NOT NULL, "manual_price_m3" INTEGER NULL, "effective_price_m3" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (effective_price_m3 >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_product_discounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "discount_rate" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (discount_rate >= 0 AND discount_rate <= 10000));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cash_accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "bank_name" TEXT NULL, "iban" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inventory_batches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "variant_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES product_variants (id), "location_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES locations (id), "supplier_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id), "source_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NULL, "parent_batch_id" TEXT NULL, "received_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bare_unit_cost_m3" INTEGER NOT NULL, "real_unit_cost_m3" INTEGER NOT NULL, "in_pieces" INTEGER NOT NULL, "in_volume" INTEGER NOT NULL, "remaining_pieces" INTEGER NOT NULL, "remaining_volume" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (in_pieces > 0 AND in_volume > 0), CHECK (remaining_pieces >= 0 AND remaining_volume >= 0), CHECK (remaining_pieces <= in_pieces AND remaining_volume <= in_volume), CHECK (bare_unit_cost_m3 >= 0 AND real_unit_cost_m3 >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "location_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES locations (id), "variant_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES product_variants (id), "batch_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES inventory_batches (id), "pieces" INTEGER NOT NULL, "volume" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_cost_m3" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_cost" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NULL, "reversal_of_id" TEXT NULL, "command_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (pieces <> 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cost_allocations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "movement_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stock_movements (id), "batch_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES inventory_batches (id), "pieces" INTEGER NOT NULL, "volume" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_cost_m3" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_cost" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sequence_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (pieces > 0), CHECK (sequence_no >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cost_adjustments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "batch_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES inventory_batches (id), "purchase_expense_id" TEXT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "volume_affected" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "period_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (reason IN ('LATE_EXPENSE','CUTTING_FEE_LATE','OTHER')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchases" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "doc_no" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "supplier_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id), "doc_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "due_date" INTEGER NULL, "price_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "invoice_no" TEXT NULL, "waybill_no" TEXT NULL, "subtotal_net" INTEGER NOT NULL, "vat_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "grand_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expense_total" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE', "cancelled_at" INTEGER NULL, "cancel_reason" TEXT NULL, "command_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchase_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "purchase_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES purchases (id), "line_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "variant_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES product_variants (id), "pieces" INTEGER NOT NULL, "volume" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_price_m3" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discount_rate" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "net_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "vat_rate" INTEGER NOT NULL, "vat_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "gross_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "batch_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES inventory_batches (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (pieces > 0 AND volume > 0), CHECK (vat_rate >= 0 AND vat_rate <= 10000), CHECK (discount_rate >= 0 AND discount_rate <= 10000));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchase_expenses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "purchase_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES purchases (id), "supplier_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "vat_rate" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "allocation_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'VOLUME', "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "added_later" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("added_later" IN (0, 1)), "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (kind IN ('NAKLIYE','HAMALIYE','DIGER')), CHECK (amount >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchase_expense_allocations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "purchase_expense_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES purchase_expenses (id), "batch_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES inventory_batches (id), "volume_share" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount_to_stock" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount_to_adjustment" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchase_returns" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "doc_no" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "purchase_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES purchases (id), "supplier_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id), "doc_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "price_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "subtotal_net" INTEGER NOT NULL, "vat_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "grand_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cost_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE', "cancelled_at" INTEGER NULL, "cancel_reason" TEXT NULL, "command_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchase_return_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "purchase_return_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES purchase_returns (id), "purchase_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES purchase_items (id), "batch_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES inventory_batches (id), "pieces" INTEGER NOT NULL, "volume" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_price_m3" INTEGER NOT NULL, "net_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "vat_rate" INTEGER NOT NULL, "vat_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "gross_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cost_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (pieces > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sales_quotes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "doc_no" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "doc_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "valid_until" INTEGER NULL, "price_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "subtotal_net" INTEGER NOT NULL, "vat_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "grand_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT', "converted_sale_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sales_quote_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sales_quote_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sales_quotes (id), "line_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "variant_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES product_variants (id), "pieces" INTEGER NOT NULL, "volume" INTEGER NOT NULL, "list_price_m3" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discount_rate" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "unit_price_m3" INTEGER NOT NULL, "net_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "vat_rate" INTEGER NOT NULL, "vat_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "gross_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (pieces > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sales" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "doc_no" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "sales_quote_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sales_quotes (id), "doc_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "due_date" INTEGER NULL, "price_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "invoice_no" TEXT NULL, "waybill_no" TEXT NULL, "subtotal_net" INTEGER NOT NULL, "vat_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "grand_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cost_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE', "cancelled_at" INTEGER NULL, "cancel_reason" TEXT NULL, "command_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sale_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sale_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sales (id), "line_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "variant_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES product_variants (id), "pieces" INTEGER NOT NULL, "volume" INTEGER NOT NULL, "price_list_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES price_lists (id), "list_price_m3" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discount_rate" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "unit_price_m3" INTEGER NOT NULL, "net_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "vat_rate" INTEGER NOT NULL, "vat_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "gross_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cost_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (pieces > 0 AND volume > 0), CHECK (vat_rate >= 0 AND vat_rate <= 10000), CHECK (discount_rate >= 0 AND discount_rate <= 10000));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sale_returns" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "doc_no" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "sale_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sales (id), "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "doc_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "price_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "subtotal_net" INTEGER NOT NULL, "vat_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "grand_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cost_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE', "cancelled_at" INTEGER NULL, "cancel_reason" TEXT NULL, "command_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sale_return_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sale_return_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sale_returns (id), "sale_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sale_items (id), "pieces" INTEGER NOT NULL, "volume" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_price_m3" INTEGER NOT NULL, "net_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "vat_rate" INTEGER NOT NULL, "vat_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "gross_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cost_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (pieces > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_ledger" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "doc_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "doc_id" TEXT NULL, "doc_no" TEXT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "due_date" INTEGER NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "reversal_of_id" TEXT NULL, "command_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "supplier_ledger" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "supplier_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id), "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "doc_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "doc_id" TEXT NULL, "doc_no" TEXT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "due_date" INTEGER NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "reversal_of_id" TEXT NULL, "command_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "collections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "doc_no" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "doc_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "cash_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES cash_accounts (id), "instrument_id" TEXT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE', "cancelled_at" INTEGER NULL, "cancel_reason" TEXT NULL, "command_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (amount > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "supplier_payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "doc_no" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "supplier_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id), "doc_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "cash_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES cash_accounts (id), "instrument_id" TEXT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE', "cancelled_at" INTEGER NULL, "cancel_reason" TEXT NULL, "command_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (amount > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payment_allocations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "collection_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES collections (id), "target_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_manual" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_manual" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (target_type IN ('SALE','OPENING','SALE_RETURN')), CHECK (amount > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "supplier_payment_allocations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "supplier_payment_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES supplier_payments (id), "target_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_manual" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_manual" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (target_type IN ('PURCHASE','OPENING','CUTTING_ORDER')), CHECK (amount > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "account_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cash_account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cash_accounts (id), "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_type" TEXT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NULL, "counter_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES cash_accounts (id), "reversal_of_id" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "command_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (direction IN ('IN','OUT')), CHECK (amount > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transfers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "doc_no" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "from_account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cash_accounts (id), "to_account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cash_accounts (id), "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "doc_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE', "cancelled_at" INTEGER NULL, "cancel_reason" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (from_account_id <> to_account_id), CHECK (amount > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expenses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "doc_no" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES expense_categories (id), "supplier_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id), "doc_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount_net" INTEGER NOT NULL, "vat_rate" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "vat_total" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "gross_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cash_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES cash_accounts (id), "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE', "cancelled_at" INTEGER NULL, "cancel_reason" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "instruments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "serial_no" TEXT NULL, "bank_name" TEXT NULL, "branch" TEXT NULL, "drawer_name" TEXT NULL, "due_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "supplier_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id), "endorsed_to_supplier_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id), "current_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_type" TEXT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (amount > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "instrument_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "instrument_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES instruments (id), "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "from_status" TEXT NULL, "to_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "cash_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES cash_accounts (id), "counterparty_id" TEXT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reversal_of_id" TEXT NULL, "command_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_counts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "doc_no" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "location_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES locations (id), "count_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT', "applied_at" INTEGER NULL, "cost_effect_total" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "command_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT','APPLIED','CANCELLED')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_count_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "stock_count_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stock_counts (id), "variant_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES product_variants (id), "system_pieces" INTEGER NOT NULL, "counted_pieces" INTEGER NOT NULL, "diff_pieces" INTEGER NOT NULL, "diff_volume" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cost_effect" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (system_pieces >= 0 AND counted_pieces >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_adjustments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "doc_no" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "cost_total" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE', "cancelled_at" INTEGER NULL, "cancel_reason" TEXT NULL, "command_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_adjustment_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "stock_adjustment_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stock_adjustments (id), "variant_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES product_variants (id), "pieces" INTEGER NOT NULL, "volume" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cost_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (pieces > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cutting_orders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "doc_no" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "cutter_supplier_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id), "sales_quote_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sales_quotes (id), "customer_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "sent_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expected_return_date" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PREPARING', "cutting_fee_net" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "cutting_fee_vat_rate" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "freight_net" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "source_volume_total" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "result_volume_total" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "waste_volume" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "command_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (result_volume_total <= source_volume_total));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cutting_order_sources" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cutting_order_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cutting_orders (id), "source_batch_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES inventory_batches (id), "kesimde_batch_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES inventory_batches (id), "variant_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES product_variants (id), "pieces" INTEGER NOT NULL, "volume" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cost_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (pieces > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cutting_order_plan_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cutting_order_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cutting_orders (id), "variant_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES product_variants (id), "planned_pieces" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (planned_pieces > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cutting_order_results" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cutting_order_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cutting_orders (id), "variant_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES product_variants (id), "result_batch_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES inventory_batches (id), "pieces" INTEGER NOT NULL, "volume" INTEGER NOT NULL, "allocated_cost" INTEGER NOT NULL, "returned_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_remnant" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_remnant" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (pieces > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "opening_balances" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_id" TEXT NULL, "as_of_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "pieces" INTEGER NULL, "unit_cost_m3" INTEGER NULL, "due_date" INTEGER NULL, "created_record_id" TEXT NULL, "command_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (kind IN ('STOCK','CUSTOMER','SUPPLIER','CASH','INSTRUMENT')));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_users_username ON users (username)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_docseq_type_year ON document_sequences (doc_type, year)
CREATE INDEX idx_audit_occurred ON audit_logs (occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_audit_entity ON audit_logs (entity_type, entity_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_backuplog_occurred ON backup_log (occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_products_norm ON products (name_normalized)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_variant_unique ON product_variants (product_id, width, height, thickness, kind)
